name: Banh beo
summary: Banh beo is a set of small steamed rice cakes in little dishes, topped with shrimp and eaten with a sweet-salty dip. In Da Nang the order is often bèo, nậm, and lọc together.
origin: Hue steamed cakes, eaten all along the coast. Da Nang shops sell the set as a snack or a light lunch.
howToEat: Spoon a little dip into each cup, then eat the cake from the dish. A fork flattens it.
Order the set if the sign says bèo nậm lọc. The three cakes are different textures of the same snack.
Afternoon is the easy hour. It is not a beach dinner.
where: Bà Bé is at 100 Hoàng Văn Thụ. Order the bèo nậm lọc set.
In Hue, Vietnam Tourism sends you to Dong Ba market and then to bánh bèo and bánh khoái. No Hue street number and no Hue shop are published here. Check on arrival.
priceBand: A snack plate, cheaper than a noodle lunch.
seoTitle: Banh beo — steamed rice cakes in Da Nang
seoDescription: Banh beo nam loc are small steamed rice cakes eaten with a spoon of dip. In Da Nang, Ba Be serves the set at 100 Hoang Van Thu in the afternoon.
